section.content: 机器学习装置(1)对电动机驱动装置(2)的警报原因进行学习，该机器学习装置(1)具有：状态观测部(10)，其取得包含从电动机驱动装置(2)取得的从电动机检测出的电流检测值、对电动机的转速进行指定的速度指令值、输出至电动机的输出电压值、电动机的速度推定值及电动机的速度检测值中的至少1者在内的特征量而作为状态变量，取得与特征量对应的警报原因而作为标签数据；以及学习部(11)，其生成学习模型，该学习模型用于根据基于状态变量及标签数据的组合创建的数据集对与新的特征量对应的新的警报原因进行推定。

A machine learning device (1) learns an alarm cause of a motor drive device (2), the machine learning device (1) comprising a state observation unit (10) that acquires, as a state variable, a feature quantity including at least 1 of a current detection value detected from a motor acquired from the motor drive device (2), a speed command value specifying the rotational speed of the motor, an output voltage value output to the motor, a speed estimation value of the motor, and a speed detection value of the motor, and acquires, as tag data, an alarm cause corresponding to the feature quantity, and a learning unit (11) that generates a learning model for estimating, from a data set created based on a combination of the state variable and the tag data, a new alarm cause corresponding to a new feature quantity.

Machine learning device and machine learning methodTechnical Field

The present invention relates to a machine learning device and a machine learning method for learning an alarm cause of a motor driving device that drives a motor.

Background

When the motor driving device that drives the motor is in the alarm state, the parameter of the motor driving device is changed, the system including the motor driving device is adjusted, and the like, in addition to the determination of the cause of the alarm.

The fault diagnosis device described in patent document 1 observes data or the like at a fault time of the motor drive device as a state variable, acquires repair component data or the like indicating a component repaired by the motor drive device as tag data, and learns the correlation between the state variable and the tag data. The fault diagnosis device uses the learning result to estimate which part of the motor drive device has failed.

Patent document 1 Japanese patent application laid-open No. 2019-144174

Disclosure of Invention

However, in the technique of patent document 1, since the failure location in the case where a failure occurs in a component is learned, the failure cause in the case where a failure occurs in a component can be estimated, but the alarm cause that is not due to a physical failure of a component or the like but due to a problem of a usage pattern cannot be estimated.

The present invention has been made in view of the above-described problems, and an object of the present invention is to provide a machine learning device capable of generating a learning model for estimating an alarm cause due to a problem of a usage pattern.

In order to solve the above problems and achieve the object, a machine learning device for learning an alarm cause of a motor driving device for driving a motor according to the present invention includes a state observation unit and a learning unit. The state observation unit acquires the feature quantity acquired from the motor drive device as a state variable, and acquires an alarm cause corresponding to the feature quantity as tag data. The characteristic amount includes at least 1 of a current detection value detected from the motor, a speed command value specifying the rotational speed of the motor, an output voltage value output to the motor, a speed estimation value indicating the estimated rotational speed of the motor, and a speed detection value indicating the detected rotational speed of the motor. The learning unit generates a learning model for estimating a new alarm cause corresponding to the new feature amount from a data set created based on the combination of the state variable and the tag data.

ADVANTAGEOUS EFFECTS OF INVENTION

The machine learning device according to the present invention has an effect of being able to generate a learning model for estimating the cause of an alarm generated due to a problem of a usage pattern.

Detailed Description

The machine learning device and the machine learning method according to the embodiment of the present invention will be described in detail below with reference to the drawings. The present invention is not limited to this embodiment.

Description of the embodiments

Fig. 1 is a diagram for explaining a process of a learning stage performed by the machine learning device according to the embodiment. Fig. 2 is a diagram for explaining a process of an estimation stage performed by the machine learning device according to the embodiment.

The machine learning device 1 learns the state of a motor driving device that drives a motor. The machine learning device 1 is a computer that estimates the cause of an alarm (hereinafter referred to as an alarm cause) generated by a motor drive device by an artificial intelligence (AI: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE) technique and notifies an operator of the alarm cause, parameters for canceling the alarm cause, and the like.

As shown in fig. 1, the machine learning device 1 acquires information indicating the state of the motor driving device that has generated an alarm in the learning stage. The information indicating the state of the motor drive device that generated the alarm is the alarm cause 32A and the drive data feature quantity 31A.

The drive data feature quantity 31A is a feature quantity extracted by the motor drive device from a physical quantity acquired by the motor drive device when an alarm at the learning stage is generated. The alarm cause 32A is an alarm cause in the learning stage, and corresponds to the drive data feature amount 31A. The alarm cause 32A is set by an operator or the like.

The machine learning device 1 learns as a learning model representing the relationship between the warning cause 32A and the drive data feature quantity 31A as the state of the motor drive device. In other words, the machine learning device 1 learns the alarm cause 32A corresponding to the drive data feature quantity 31A.

As shown in fig. 2, the machine learning device 1 uses a learning model to estimate, in the estimation stage, the alarm cause 32B indicating the state of the motor driving device that has generated the alarm, based on the driving data feature amount 31B indicating the state of the motor driving device that has generated the alarm. The machine learning device 1 acquires the in-design data 33 in the estimation stage.

The drive data feature quantity 31B is a feature quantity extracted by the motor drive device from a physical quantity acquired by the motor drive device at the time of alarm generation in the estimation stage. The alarm cause 32B is an alarm cause in the estimation stage, and corresponds to the drive data feature amount 31B. The driving data feature quantity 31B is applied to the learning model, whereby the alarm cause 32B is derived.

In the following description, when it is not necessary to distinguish between the drive data feature amounts 31A and 31B, at least one of the drive data feature amounts 31A and 31B may be referred to as a feature amount or a drive data feature amount. In addition, when it is not necessary to distinguish between the alarm causes 32A and 32B, at least one of the alarm causes 32A and 32B may be referred to as an alarm cause.

For example, the motor driving device acquires the driving data feature values 31A and 31B when an alarm is generated. The physical quantity obtained by the motor driving device includes at least 1 of a current detection value, a speed command value, an output voltage value, and a speed estimation value. The motor driving device may acquire the speed detection value instead of the speed estimation value or together with the speed estimation value. The drive data feature amounts 31A, 31B include at least 1 of a feature amount of the current detection value, a feature amount of the speed command value, a feature amount of the output voltage value, a feature amount of the speed estimation value, and a feature amount of the speed detection value.

The characteristic amounts of the respective physical amounts are a maximum value, a minimum value, a peak value, an average value, and the like of the respective physical amounts. The physical quantity obtained by the motor driving device is represented by waveform data, for example.

The current detection value is a current value detected from the motor when the motor is driven, and the speed command value is a command value for specifying the rotational speed of the motor. The output voltage value is a voltage value output to the motor when the motor is driven, and the speed estimation value is a rotational speed of the motor estimated when the motor is driven. The speed estimation value is estimated based on various command values, detection values, and the like. The speed detection value is a rotational speed of the motor detected when the motor is driven.

The in-design data 33 includes at least 1 of parameter set values set in the motor drive device, drive conditions of the motor drive device, and internal data of an amplifier that amplifies electric power output from the motor drive device. Examples of parameter settings are motor torque boost settings. An example of a driving situation is the control period of the motor. An example of internal data of an amplifier is the number of legs of the switching legs.

The alarm has overcurrent, overvoltage, overspeed, motor overheat, inverter overheat, and the like. The overcurrent means that the current flowing through the motor exceeds the allowable current, and the overvoltage means that the voltage applied to the amplifier exceeds the allowable voltage. The over-speed means that the rotational speed of the motor exceeds the allowable speed. Motor overheat means that the temperature of the motor exceeds an allowable temperature, and inverter overheat means that an inverter circuit that gives a voltage to the motor exceeds an allowable temperature.

Here, machine learning performed by the machine learning device 1 will be described. The machine learning device 1 extracts, from a set of data input to the machine learning device 1, useful rules, knowledge expressions, judgment criteria, and the like existing in the set by analysis, outputs the extraction result, and performs learning of knowledge, thereby realizing machine learning. The methods of machine learning are various and are broadly classified into "learning with teacher", "learning without teacher", and "reinforcement learning".

The machine learning device 1 of the present embodiment adopts an algorithm of "learning with teacher". When the machine learning device 1 performs "teacher learning", a large number of data sets for which some input and result (tag data described later) are acquired are used, and features included in these data sets are learned. The machine learning device 1 obtains a model (hereinafter referred to as a learning model) for estimating a result from an input, that is, a correlation between the input and the result. The machine learning device 1 implements a learning model for estimating a result from an input using an algorithm such as extreme gradient enhancement described later.

The machine learning device 1 can learn based on the explicit data, and perform teacher learning capable of determining the cause of the alarm of the motor driving device based on the learning result, thereby learning the correlation between the feature quantity and the cause of the alarm.

The processing performed by the machine learning device 1 that performs teacher learning can be divided into two phases, i.e., a learning phase and an estimation phase. In the learning phase, the machine learning device 1 learns the correlation between the feature quantity and the alarm cause based on teacher data including the value of the state variable used as input data and the value of the destination variable used as output data. When teacher data is given, the machine learning device 1 performs learning to output the value of the target variable based on the correlation obtained by the learning when the value of the state variable is input. The machine learning device 1 constructs a learning model, which is an estimation model for outputting a value of a target variable corresponding to a value of a state variable, by giving a large amount of teacher data.

The state variable is the drive data feature quantity 31A or the drive data feature quantity 31B, and the destination variable is the alarm cause 32A or the alarm cause 32B. The destination variable is the alarm cause 32A when the state variable is the drive data feature quantity 31A, and the destination variable is the alarm cause 32B when the state variable is the drive data feature quantity 31B.

Examples of the state variables are a characteristic amount of the current detection value, a characteristic amount of the speed command value, and the like. The value of the target variable is, for example, a value indicating that "the acceleration time of the motor is set short for the load".

In this way, the machine learning device 1 in the learning stage learns a learning model that shows the correlation between the feature quantity and the alarm cause if the teacher data (the group of the feature quantity and the alarm cause) that is the state variable is given.

If the value of the state variable is newly input, the machine learning device 1 in the estimation stage outputs the value of the target variable corresponding to the new state variable using the learning model. Specifically, as shown in fig. 2, the machine learning device 1 receives a new drive data feature quantity 31B, which is a new state variable value (st 1). Then, the machine learning device 1 estimates (st 2) a new alarm cause 32B, which is a new value of a target variable, based on the new driving data feature amount 31B, which is a new value of a state variable, and the trained learning model, and outputs the estimated new value to a display device (not shown) or the like.

The feature amount may be included in a feature amount that is normally extracted by the motor drive device. In this case, there is no alarm cause corresponding to the feature quantity at the time of normal.

The machine learning device 1 further includes a unique estimating unit 14 that is a correction unit of the learning model. The individual estimating unit 14 receives the alarm cause 32B, which is the estimation result obtained by the teacher learning, from the learning model (st 3). The individual estimating unit 14 receives the in-design data 33, which is the acquired data when the motor driving device generates an alarm, from the motor driving device or the like (st 4).

The individual estimating unit 14 corrects the estimated result, that is, the alarm cause 32B, based on the alarm cause 32B received from the learning model and the in-design data 33 received from the motor driving device, thereby improving the accuracy of the estimated result obtained by the machine learning. Specifically, the individual estimating unit 14 corrects the alarm cause 32B based on the alarm cause 32B and the in-design data 33, and outputs the corrected alarm cause, that is, the alarm cause 32C (st 5).

The independent estimating unit 14 corrects the alarm cause 32B, which is the estimation result, so that the machine learning device 1 can estimate the alarm cause that is difficult to be characterized in the state variable with high accuracy. Examples of the alarm cause 32C which is difficult to be characterized in the state variable are erroneous setting of the parameter setting value, and the like.

The in-design data 33 may include change information indicating a parameter set value that is changed before the abnormal operation, among the parameter set values. In this case, the individual estimating unit 14 corrects the alarm cause estimated from the learning model based on the change information.

Thus, when the alarm cause is the setting of the erroneous parameter set value by the operator, the machine learning device 1 can easily determine the alarm cause. Even if the alarm cause is erroneous setting of the parameter setting value, if the in-design data 33 includes change information, the individual estimating unit 14 can grasp which parameter setting value was changed before the abnormal operation, and therefore can improve the accuracy of determining the alarm cause for erroneous setting.

The machine learning device 1 may generate or update the learning model by increasing the weight of the alarm cause corresponding to the parameter set value of the change information. In addition, the machine learning device 1 may generate or update the learning model when the abnormality is released by changing the parameter set value after the abnormality has occurred.

The machine learning device 1 may store the value of the estimation result corrected by the independent estimating unit 14 as an error variable, and correct the learning model based on the error variable. In this case, the machine learning device 1 corrects the learning model so that the learning model can calculate the same estimation result as the estimation result corrected by the alone estimating unit 14. In other words, the machine learning device 1 corrects the learning model so that the learning model can calculate the same estimation result as in the case where the correction is performed by the independent estimating unit 14 even in the case where the correction is not performed by the independent estimating unit 14.

The machine learning device 1 obtains a target variable from the state variable by classification of the tree structure using the decision tree. Fig. 3 is a diagram showing a schematic configuration example of a decision tree used in the machine learning device according to the embodiment. The machine learning device 1 adjusts the learning result by adjusting the depth of the tree structure of the decision tree 40A. Decision tree 40A is a regression tree showing how the input feature quantity is conditional branched before the tag data as a positive solution is reached.

In the decision tree 40A, it is determined whether or not the state variable, i.e., the input data 41, is x1>0 in the conditional branch of the layer 1. At layer 1, if the input data 41 is x1>0, a determination is made as to whether x2>0 is in the conditional branch of layer 2, and if the input data 41 is x 1+.0, a determination is made as to whether x3>0 is in the conditional branch of layer 2.

At layer 2, if input data 41 is x2>0, input data 41 is returned to data y1, and if input data 41 is x 2≤0, input data 41 is returned to data y2.

At layer 2, if input data 41 is x3>0, input data 41 is returned to data y3, and if input data 41 is x 3≤0, input data 41 is returned to data y4.

In this case, for example, the data y2 is the output data 45. That is, the data y2 is a destination variable (tag data). The machine learning device 1 generates a learning model by setting a decision tree 40A capable of returning the state variable to the data y 2.

In addition, as an application of the decision tree to a method for learning by a teacher, the machine learning device 1 may use a method such as an extreme gradient enhancement (XGBoost: eXtreme Gradient Boosting). Extreme gradient enhancement is an integrated learning that combines gradient enhancement (Gradient Boosting) with random forests (Random Forests).

Fig. 4 is a diagram for explaining gradient reinforcement used in the machine learning device according to the embodiment. Gradient enhancement is a method of learning so as to minimize an error between the estimation result of a weak learner (decision tree of shallow layer, etc.) and positive solution information. Only by the weak learner such as the decision tree 40A, an error occurs between the output data 45, which is the estimation result obtained by the decision tree 40A, and the actual positive solution information (tag data).

When gradient reinforcement is used, the machine learning device 1 learns the error at this time as a target variable and corrects the weak learner, thereby improving the accuracy. The machine learning device 1 corrects the decision tree 40A to the decision tree 40B, for example, to reduce an error between the output data 45 and the actual positive solution information.

The machine learning device 1 generates the decision tree 40B from the decision tree 40A by setting, for example, the decision tree 40B in which x1>0, which is a conditional branch of the 1 st layer, is corrected to x4>0 and x2>0, which is a conditional branch of the 2 nd layer, is corrected to x5> 0. Thereafter, the machine learning device 1 generates a new decision tree in which x4>0, which is a conditional branch of layer 1, in the decision tree 40B is corrected to other branch conditions, and x5>0, which is a conditional branch of layer 2, is corrected to other branch conditions.

The machine learning device 1 repeatedly performs processing of generating a new decision tree in which the branching conditions are corrected so that an error between the output data 45 and the actual forward solution information is reduced. Thereby, the machine learning device 1 can obtain a decision tree in which the difference between the output data 45 and the actual positive solution information is small.

The method of learning the error a plurality of times to improve the precision of the weak learner is gradient enhancement so that the error between the output data 45 outputted from the generated decision tree and the actual forward solution information is infinitely minimized, and the gradient enhancement concerning the decision tree is referred to as gradient enhancement tree (GRADIENT TREE Boosting).

Fig. 5 is a diagram for explaining a random forest used in the machine learning device according to the embodiment. When a random forest is used, the machine learning device 1 uses a plurality of decision trees and adopts a majority decision rule, thereby improving the accuracy of the estimation result. In fig. 5, the case where the machine learning device 1 uses 4 decision trees 51 to 54 will be described. Decision trees 51 to 54 are the same decision tree as decision tree 40A.

When using a random forest, the machine learning device 1 performs an operation of randomly acquiring the input data 41 a plurality of times and creating the decision trees, thereby creating the decision trees 51 to 54. In this way, the machine learning device 1 can select the classification method of each mode by using the decision trees 51 to 54, and therefore the estimation result becomes highly accurate compared with the classification by a single decision tree. The machine learning device 1 applies decision trees 51 to 54 to the input data 41, and outputs the results based on the majority decision rule in the decision trees 51 to 54 as output data 45.

The machine learning device 1 may use any teacher learning algorithm such as a least square method, a stepwise method, an SVM (support vector machine: support Vector Machine), or a neural network as the teacher learning algorithm. Since each teacher learning algorithm such as the teacher learning and the decision tree learning is known, a detailed description of each algorithm is omitted.

Here, a specific configuration of the machine learning device 1 and a flow of the process of estimating the cause of the alarm will be described. Fig. 6 is a diagram showing a configuration of a machine learning device according to the embodiment. The machine learning device 1 is connected to the motor driving device 2 and the alarm management device 6. The machine learning device 1 obtains the drive data feature quantity from the motor drive device 2 and obtains information such as the cause of an alarm from the alarm management device 6.

The machine learning device 1 is mounted as an information processing device such as a computer connected to the motor driving device 2, for example. The machine learning device 1 includes a state observation unit 10, a learning unit 11, a learning result storage unit 12, an alarm estimation unit 13, an individual estimation unit 14, a model update unit 15, and an estimation result output unit 16.

The motor driving device 2 is a device that drives a motor, not shown. The motor driving device 2 includes a data acquisition unit 21, a feature amount extraction unit 22, and a nonvolatile memory 23. The alarm management device 6 is a device that receives an alarm cause input by an operator. The alarm management device 6 includes an input unit 61, a storage unit 62, and an output unit 63.

The data acquisition unit 21 of the motor drive device 2 acquires physical quantities (data indicating the physical quantities) such as a current detection value, a speed command value, an output voltage value, and a speed estimation value from an amplifier or the like, and sends the physical quantities to the feature quantity extraction unit 22. The data acquisition unit 21 acquires the alarm generation date and time, the name of the alarm, and the alarm content together with the physical quantity at the time of alarm generation. The data acquisition unit 21 acquires the design data from the motor drive device 2, and stores the design data in the nonvolatile memory 23.

The feature amount extraction unit 22 extracts driving data feature amounts from the physical amounts acquired by the data acquisition unit 21. The feature extraction unit 22 may digitize the drive data feature using a normal statistical method, or may reduce the dimension by convolution to extract the drive data feature.

The nonvolatile memory 23 stores the drive data feature extracted by the feature extraction unit 22. Specifically, the nonvolatile memory 23 stores feature information in which the drive data feature amount, the alarm generation date and time, the name of the alarm, and the alarm content are associated. The nonvolatile memory 23 stores in-design information in which in-design data, an alarm generation date and time, an alarm name, and alarm content are associated with each other.

The nonvolatile memory 23 has a function of outputting feature information including the drive data feature amount to the machine learning device 1 and the alarm management device 6. The nonvolatile memory 23 has a function of outputting the in-design information including the in-design data to the machine learning device 1. The nonvolatile memory 23 may be a cloud server disposed outside the motor drive device 2.

The input unit 61 of the alarm management device 6 reads out the characteristic information including the drive data characteristic amount from the nonvolatile memory 23. The drive data feature amount may be transmitted from the nonvolatile memory 23 to the input unit 61.

The input unit 61 of the alarm management device 6 receives the alarm cause and the alarm cause cancellation parameter input by the operator. The alarm cause release parameter is a parameter of a cause for releasing an alarm. In other words, the alarm cause cancellation parameter is a measure that should be performed by the operator in order to cancel the alarm.

The operator inputs the alarm cause and the alarm cause cancellation parameter to the input unit 61 while referring to the feature information stored in the alarm management device 6. The input unit 61 causes the storage unit 62 to store alarm information in which the alarm cause, the alarm cause cancellation parameter, and the information identifying the alarm are associated. An example of the alarm identification information, which is information for identifying an alarm, is the alarm generation date and time included in the feature information.

The storage unit 62 is a memory or the like for storing alarm information. The output unit 63 transmits the alarm information stored in the storage unit 62 to the state observation unit 10. The machine learning device 1 may read the alarm information from the storage unit 62.

The state observation unit 10 reads out feature information including the drive data feature amount from the nonvolatile memory 23, and observes the drive data feature amount as a state variable. The nonvolatile memory 23 may transmit the feature information to the state observation unit 10.

The state observation unit 10 reads out alarm information corresponding to the drive data feature from the alarm management device 6. At this time, the state observation unit 10 reads out alarm information corresponding to the alarm identification information included in the feature information from the alarm management device 6. Thus, the state observation unit 10 observes the cause of the alarm included in the alarm information as a target variable. The state observation unit 10 associates the driving data feature amount with the alarm cause based on the alarm identification information. The state observation unit 10 transmits the data set of the driving data feature quantity and the alarm cause as teacher data to the learning unit 11.

The state observation unit 10 may change the acquired drive data feature amount for each control system of the motor. That is, the state observation unit 10 may acquire the drive data feature amount according to the control system of the motor. The control system of the motor includes vector control, sensorless vector control, V/f (Voltage/frequency) control, AD (Advanced) magnetic flux vector) magnetic flux control, and the like. The V/f control is control for outputting a voltage corresponding to a frequency.

When the motor control system is vector control or sensorless vector control, the state observation unit 10 obtains the drive data feature quantity including at least 1 of the speed detection value, the speed estimation value, and the speed command value. In addition, the state observation unit 10 obtains the drive data feature quantity including at least 1 of the output voltage value and the current detection value when the motor control system is neither vector control nor sensorless vector control.

The learning unit 11 performs teacher learning. When the machine learning device 1 is set to the learning stage, the learning unit 11 performs teacher learning, and stores a learning model, which is a learning result, in the learning result storage unit 12. The learning unit 11 of the present embodiment performs teacher learning by taking as input a driving data feature quantity, which is a state variable, and an alarm cause, which is a target variable.

The learning unit 11 learns the cause of the alarm using the drive data feature quantity extracted from the physical quantity acquired when the motor drive device 2 generates the alarm. Since the drive data feature amount is already stored in the nonvolatile memory 23, the learning unit 11 may learn the cause of the alarm by using the past drive data feature amount. In this case, the learning unit 11 learns the cause of the alarm by using the past alarm cause corresponding to the past drive data feature quantity.

Fig. 7 is a diagram for explaining an example of an alarm cause used in the machine learning device according to the embodiment. Fig. 7 shows correspondence information obtained by associating the alarm generation date and time, the generation alarm, the alarm content, the alarm cause, and the alarm cause cancellation parameter.

The alarm generation date and time is the date and time when the alarm was generated, the generated alarm is the name of the alarm, and the alarm content is the content of the alarm.

An example of the alarm content is an overcurrent when accelerating the motor (overcurrent when accelerating). An example of the cause of the alarm is that the acceleration time of the motor is set short for the load. An example of the alarm cause release parameter is the acceleration time of the motor. For example, if an overcurrent is generated when accelerating the motor because the acceleration time of the motor is set to be short for the load, the alarm can be released by setting the acceleration time of the motor to be long.

When an alarm is generated by the motor drive device 2, an operator who has dealt with the alarm inputs an alarm cause and an alarm cause cancellation parameter to the input unit 61 of the alarm management device 6. The alarm management device 6 may be disposed in the machine learning device 1 or in the motor driving device 2. The input of the alarm cause, the alarm cause cancellation parameter, and the like to the alarm management device 6 by the operator may be performed when the alarm is handled, or may be input afterwards during alarm analysis, and the like. The correspondence information may be created by the state observation unit 10 or by the learning unit 11.

The learning unit 11 sets 1 group of driving data feature values generated from physical quantities acquired when an alarm corresponding to the alarm cause is generated, and inputs the driving data feature values to the learning model. More specifically, the learning unit 11 sets 1 group of driving data feature values and alarm causes extracted from physical quantities in a specific period acquired by triggering an alarm generation of the alarm causes, and inputs the driving data feature values and the alarm causes to the learning model.

In this way, the learning unit 11 can adopt the teacher learning method when the driving data feature amount and the alarm cause are input. In this case, the learning unit 11 uses the extreme gradient enhancement to estimate the cause of the alarm with respect to the drive data feature amount. The learning unit 11 causes the learning result storage unit 12 to store a learning model as a learning result.

The learning result storage unit 12 is a memory or the like that stores a result (learning model) obtained by the learning unit 11 learning based on teacher data. The learning result stored in the learning result storage unit 12 may be installed in an external device other than the machine learning device 1, or may be transmitted to the external device. By inputting the drive data feature amount to the learning result obtained by the learning unit 11 by the external device, the external device can estimate the cause of the alarm. The learning result storage unit 12 may store the correspondence information shown in fig. 7.

The alarm estimating unit 13 estimates the cause of the alarm from the drive data feature amount based on the learning result stored in the learning result storage unit 12 in the estimating stage. In this case, the alarm estimating unit 13 acquires the drive data feature value from the motor drive device 2. The drive data feature amount may be read out from the nonvolatile memory 23 by the alarm estimating unit 13, or may be transmitted from the nonvolatile memory 23 to the alarm estimating unit 13. The alarm estimating unit 13 outputs the estimated cause of the alarm to the individual estimating unit 14.

The individual estimating unit 14 inputs the cause of the alarm estimated by the alarm estimating unit 13 and the in-design information stored in the nonvolatile memory 23. The individual estimating unit 14 determines whether or not correction of the estimated alarm cause is necessary based on the alarm cause estimated by the alarm estimating unit 13 and on the intra-design data, which is the data at the time of the alarm. When the correction of the cause of the alarm is necessary, the individual estimating unit 14 corrects the estimated cause of the alarm based on the estimated cause of the alarm and the intra-design data, which is the data at the time of the alarm. The individual estimating unit 14 sends the corrected alarm cause to the model updating unit 15.

The model updating unit 15 stores the corrected position of the alarm cause corrected by the independent estimating unit 14 as an estimated error. The model updating unit 15 feeds back the estimated error to the learning unit 11, and causes the learning unit 11 to update the learning model.

If the estimated result output unit 16 acquires the alarm cause (estimated result) corrected by the independent estimating unit 14 from the independent estimating unit 14, the alarm cause cancellation parameter corresponding to the acquired alarm cause is acquired based on the correspondence information of the learning result storage unit 12.

The estimation result output unit 16 outputs the corrected alarm cause and alarm cause cancellation parameter to a display device or the like. Thereby, the alarm cause and the alarm cause cancellation parameter are displayed on a display device or the like. The operator can cancel the alarm by setting the displayed alarm cause canceling parameter to the motor driving device 2 or the like.

The 1 st alarm cause is the alarm cause acquired by the state observation unit 10, and corresponds to the alarm cause 32A described in fig. 1. The alarm cause estimated by the learning model generated by the learning unit 11, that is, the alarm cause estimated by the alarm estimating unit 13 is the 2 nd alarm cause, and corresponds to the alarm cause 32B described in fig. 2. The alarm cause estimated by the alarm estimating unit 13 is a new alarm cause corresponding to a new feature amount of the newly generated alarm.

The alarm cause corrected based on the change information by the individual estimating unit 14 is the 2 nd alarm cause, and the corrected alarm cause is the 3 rd alarm cause. The 3 rd alarm cause corresponds to the alarm cause 32C described in fig. 2.

When the learning unit 11 generates or updates the learning model by increasing the weight of the alarm cause corresponding to the parameter set value of the change information, the 3 rd alarm cause is the alarm cause, and the learning unit 11 generates or updates the learning model by using the 3 rd alarm cause as the 1 st alarm cause. When an abnormality is released by changing the parameter setting value after the occurrence of the abnormality that causes the 3 rd alarm, the learning unit 11 generates or updates the learning model.

Next, a process flow of estimating the cause of an alarm performed by the machine learning device 1 will be described. Fig. 8 is a flowchart for explaining a flow of processing for estimating the cause of an alarm by the machine learning device according to the embodiment.

If an alarm is generated, the state observation unit 10 of the machine learning device 1 acquires a feature quantity corresponding to the alarm as a state variable (step S10). The state observation unit 10 acquires an alarm cause corresponding to the alarm as a target variable (step S15).

The learning unit 11 performs teacher learning with the alarm cause, which is a state variable, that is, a feature quantity and a destination variable, as input. That is, the learning unit 11 learns the cause of the alarm corresponding to the feature amount (step S20). Specifically, the learning unit 11 sets a data set of the feature amount and the alarm cause as teacher data in a learning model, thereby learning the alarm cause.

After learning the learning model, if a new alarm is generated, the alarm estimating unit 13 receives a new feature amount corresponding to the new alarm (step S30). Then, the alarm estimating unit 13 inputs the new feature amount to the trained learning model, thereby estimating the cause of the alarm corresponding to the new feature amount (step S40). The machine learning device 1 performs the processing of steps S10, S15, and S20 in the learning phase, and performs the processing of steps S30 and S40 in the estimation phase.

In this way, since the machine learning device 1 acquires the feature quantity and the alarm cause extracted from the physical quantity, it is possible to quickly generate a learning model for estimating the alarm cause before the occurrence of the failure. That is, the machine learning device 1 can quickly generate a learning model for estimating the cause of an alarm generated due to a problem of a usage pattern, not due to a physical failure of a component or the like. In this way, the machine learning device 1 can estimate the cause of the alarm before the occurrence of the failure. That is, the machine learning device 1 can estimate the cause of the alarm due to the problem of the usage pattern. Therefore, the worker can perform the process of the alarm based on the cause of the alarm. As a result, the machine learning device 1 can shorten the downtime of the equipment at the time of alarm generation.

However, as a method of estimating the cause of the alarm, there are a method of confirming the state or parameter of the motor driving device by the operator, a method of monitoring the input/output information of the motor driving device by the operator, and the like. In this method, since the experience of the operator estimating the cause of the alarm is relied on, the speed and accuracy of determining the cause of the alarm are different from the experience of the operator and the like. In addition, in order to determine whether an alarm is caused by an erroneous setting of the motor drive device or by an alarm caused by a high load or an abnormality of the equipment, a considerable amount of time is required because sufficient input data is required.

In addition, there is a method of estimating an abnormality based on sound, vibration, and current values. In this method, in order to determine the state of the rotating body such as the motor driving device, it is difficult to obtain sufficient input data, and therefore, it is impossible to perform highly accurate estimation. There is also a method of obtaining an internal parameter of a machine learning device by performing machine learning using a state variable obtained when an abnormality is generated and a state variable obtained when no abnormality is generated. In this method, the machine learning device uses the internal parameters to make an abnormality diagnosis. In this method, it is also difficult to obtain sufficient input data in order to determine the state of the rotating body such as the motor driving device.

The input device 151 receives feature information including the drive data feature amount, alarm information including an alarm cause, design information, and the like, and transmits the received information to the processor 152. The learning program may be provided as a computer program product by being stored in a storage medium readable by a computer in a format that can be installed or a format that can be executed. The functions of the machine learning device 1 may be partially implemented by dedicated hardware such as a dedicated circuit, and partially implemented by software or firmware.

In the present embodiment, the following processing is described, in which the machine learning device 1 learns and estimates the physical quantity, the feature quantity, and the teacher data related to 1 motor driving device 2 for convenience, but the present embodiment is not limited to such processing. For example, the machine learning device 1 collects physical quantities, characteristic quantities, and teacher data concerning a plurality of motor driving devices 2 in a factory or in a plurality of sites, and learns and estimates them, so that it is possible to learn and estimate them efficiently. In other words, the machine learning device 1 can learn the cause of the alarm efficiently by using the plurality of motor driving devices 2 as learning targets.

In the present embodiment, the case where the machine learning device 1 has the learning unit 11 has been described, but the machine learning device 1 may not be provided with the learning unit 11 when the learning result storage unit 12 stores the learning result obtained by learning by another machine learning device. In other words, the machine learning device having the learning unit 11 and the machine learning device having the alarm estimating unit 13 may be separate machine learning devices.

As described above, in the embodiment, the state observation unit 10 obtains the characteristic value of the physical quantity such as the current detection value obtained from the motor drive device 2 as the state variable, and obtains the alarm cause corresponding to the characteristic value as the target variable. The learning unit 11 generates a learning model for estimating the cause of the alarm from a data set created based on a combination of the state variable and the target variable (tag data). Therefore, the machine learning device 1 can generate a learning model for estimating the cause of an alarm generated due to a problem of the usage mode, not due to a physical failure of a component or the like.

The machine learning device 1 further includes an independent estimating unit 14, and the independent estimating unit 14 corrects the alarm cause estimated by the alarm estimating unit 13 based on the in-design data, so that it is possible to diagnose the alarm cause corresponding to the driving data feature quantity with high accuracy.

Further, since the total feature amount at the time of occurrence of an alarm is stored in the nonvolatile memory 23, the machine learning device 1 can increase the number of teacher data that can be stored in the nonvolatile memory 23 by limiting the feature amount acquired for each control system of the motor, and as a result, the accuracy of estimating the cause of the alarm can be improved.
